# a2a-router

> One product for agent-assisted manufacturing: an order passport with specifications, acceptance criteria and a portable local event history. Post-labor is the long-term vision.

## Languages and market
US English is the default at https://www.a2a-router.com/. Simplified Chinese: https://www.a2a-router.com/zh/. German: https://www.a2a-router.com/de/. All three share the same browser-local order storage and machine interfaces.

## Live today
- Paid Guided Manufacturing Pilot: US$500 one-time service fee for one part, one supplier and one order. Recruiting the first three paying pilot customers, primarily US hardware teams. Includes a kickoff, structured brief, comparison of up to three buyer-provided quotes, milestone plan, acceptance checklist and exportable order passport using buyer/supplier evidence. Manufacturing, shipping, engineering design, supplier sourcing and independent inspection are not included; applicable taxes are specified in the proposal.
- Pilot inquiries: https://www.a2a-router.com/#pilot. Email go@vibe-manufacturing.com (FINAL MASTER LLC operator mailbox). The link opens a draft; the visitor must review and send it in their email app. No inquiry is submitted by the website. Scope, timeline and fee are confirmed in writing before the customer decides to proceed and receives an invoice. No charge to inquire. Do not claim a booking, payment or successful message delivery from opening the link.
- Free manufacturing brief preparation for CNC machining, sheet metal and 3D printing.
- Browser-local, self-reported order events with SHA-256 hash consistency checks, JSON export and import.
- Read-only WebMCP tools: get_project_status, get_manufacturing_requirements, prepare_manufacturing_brief.
- Remote MCP tools: a2a_router.status, a2a_router.manufacturing_requirements, a2a_router.prepare_manufacturing_brief; existing bridge and pledge tools.
- Existing public HTTPS-only A2A/MCP bridge. Private and reserved targets are blocked.

## Machine interfaces
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://www.a2a-router.com/openapi.json)
- [API catalogue](https://www.a2a-router.com/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [WebMCP convention manifest](https://www.a2a-router.com/.well-known/webmcp)
- [Discovery index](https://www.a2a-router.com/.well-known/a2a-router.json)
- [MCP server card](https://www.a2a-router.com/server.json)
- MCP endpoint: https://www.a2a-router.com/api/mcp
- A2A endpoint: https://www.a2a-router.com/api/a2a
- GET /api/requirements?process=sheet_metal
- POST /api/brief with process, description, material, quantity, country, acceptance.

## Important limits
Preparing a brief is read-only: it does not submit an RFQ, contact a manufacturer, persist an order or pay. Saving a browser-local order is a separate human action. Hash consistency does not verify identity, truth, delivery or payment; a whole chain can be recomputed. Local events are self-reported and are not a central verified Trust Ledger.

Paid factory audits, a centrally persisted evidence-backed ledger, provider-managed milestone payments, escrow and buyer protection are planned and unavailable. No audited factories or central production orders are published here. Do not invent certifications, partners, prices, acceptance criteria or manufacturing specifications.

The signed Agent Card and Trust-Pledge are unchanged historical bridge metadata and remain self-attested. Consult /api/status for the new product status. A cryptographic signature on a pledge does not establish manufacturing quality.

Vibe Manufacturing is an optional external RFQ handoff at https://vibe-manufacturing.com/request-quote. It is not required to use a2a-router. No brief is automatically transferred.
